page.overview:
Who is Colorful Carnotaurus?

The colorful Carnotaurus is a genetically modified hybrid of Carnotaurus and tree frog that appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.

A colorful variant of the Carnotaurus can be created in the game. In order to create it, a player must acquire 3 samples of Carnotaurus DNA; 2 samples of any Large DNA; and 1 sample of Tree Frog DNA.
